asha: quick async pulse — what I did / blockers / today

asha: shipped kv-cache shadowing for spanish-onboard (config toggled in staging). smoke pass for short prompts.
asha: blocker: seeing 0.5% upstream token shift on long-context (>2k) cases — trying to repro locally, might be kv eviction edge.
asha: today: iterate on repro, add a focused eval set for long-context spanish prompts, and submit CR for cache TTL tweak. cc @kevin for rollout plan

kevin: nice. would you add a small flag to skip cache for suspicious sessions? easier rollback.
kevin: also can you paste the quick repro snippet?

asha: repro snippet:```bash
# reproduce with same seed + long prompt
python run_infer.py --model llm-spanish-v1 --prompt tests/long_spanish.txt --seed 42 --max-tokens 1024 --kv-profile debug
```
asha: throwing logs into /tmp/kv-shadow-1767.log

maria: saw the 0.5% in eval dashboard too — flagged examples in the "long-context" bucket. Not severe but worth gating before prod.
maria: I can add those cases to the regression suite, will push a test set in 10–15m.

sam: small ask — can we mark this model onboarding as "no-auto-rollout" until the kv TTL CR is merged? want to avoid surprise traffic.

sam: if you want I can update the onboard config (release-tag: hold)

asha: yes please @sam — put hold. I'll open CR now.

eval-bot: eval summary (staging): llm-spanish-v1 — baseline vs shadow
- BLEU: 0.83 -> 0.828
- perplexity (long-context): 12.1 -> 12.4
- regression count: 14 / 3k samples (0.47%)
(eval-bot): flagged 7 highest-confidence regressions in /eval/flags/1767543210/

kevin: thanks @eval-bot. maria — once your reg set lands, can you run the quick A/B with TTL tweak? want numbers before we flip cache on prod.

maria: will do — scheduling run after my current job finishes (~30m).

asha: plan: 1) open CR for TTL bump + skip-flag, 2) sam puts release-tag hold, 3) maria runs A/B on reg set, 4) iterate.

kevin: sounds good. Lmk if you need me to approve CR faster.

asha: thanks all — ping me if you spot any other anomalies. :thumbsup:
